unlock: Locked thrusters give no thrust. Check the way ahead is clear, then unlock; lock again whenever you want to stop.
move: Small inputs, slowly: the sticks command thrust. Let go and the vehicle slows on water drag alone, and the current still carries it.
depth: With depth hold on, letting go of up/down keeps the current depth. Try switching it off and on again.
light: It gets darker with depth. The lights show what is ahead; in murky water suspended particles reflect them, so dim them when needed.
photo: Aim at the target and take a picture. Photos go to your collection and are mission evidence.
objectives: Peek cards show the objectives briefly without interrupting flight; the other directions show systems, map and controls.
pause: The pause menu has the current objective, settings and the controls tutorial at any time.

depthOff: With depth hold off the vehicle slowly rises or sinks. Turn it on and letting go of up/down holds the depth.
moveAssisted: Small inputs, slowly: with assist on, the vehicle brakes when you let go; a strong current can still push it.

tether: The tether is pulled tight or caught on something. Stop thrusting and back out slowly along the way you came so it can slacken.
dvl: Velocity and position assist need the DVL to see the seabed; flight is manual thrust for now.
visibility: Slow down and keep the thrusters from stirring up the seabed; navigate by depth, heading and sonar, and let the silt settle.
